name: parallel-attempts
title: Parallel attempts
author: Eduardo Retana
description: The same task tried a few ways at once. The best finished score is marked. A tie does not pick a winner.

meta.descriptionEs: La misma tarea, de varias maneras a la vez. El mejor puntaje terminado queda marcado. Un empate no elige solo.

examples.title: La nota para Celaya
examples.description: Tres maneras de escribir el pedido PED-990. Bruma va adelante.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y diez intentos.

api.name: attempts
api.description: id, agent, approach, status (running, done, failed), progress from 0 to 1, score from 0 to 100, note. meta is opaque.

api.name: pickedId
api.description: The attempt a person kept. The piece does not store it.

api.name: onPick
api.description: Keep a finished attempt. A tie leaves the choice open.

api.name: loading / error
api.description: Loading skeleton, or an alert when the attempts cannot be read.

api.name: labels
api.description: Chrome copy. English is the default.

docs: Inspirado en el comportamiento público de Affect; reimplementación clean-room; no código, datos, iconos ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos.
